title: Efficient single-component nickel catalysts with tetradentate aminopyridine ligands for cycloaddition reactions of CO2 and epoxides under mild conditions
content:
RSC Sustain., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00556B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Congcong Zhang, Minghui Shi, Ning Yu, Bowen Zhang, Feng Han, Chengxia Miao
A series of single-component nickel catalysts with tetradentate aminopyridine ligands exhibited excellent capabilities and selectivity for the synthesis of cyclic carbonates from epoxides and CO2, even under 1 atm CO2 and 0.5 mol% of the catalyst.
